what.text: This page follows refugees from Nigeria in Equatorial Guinea, for the one year UNHCR's data records them, 1968.
At the end of 1968, UNHCR counted 40000 Nigerian refugees in Equatorial Guinea, 78.3% of all refugees from Nigeria that year.
Today refugees from Nigeria live mostly in the Niger, Cameroon, Chad and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Biafra territory in Nigeria from 1967 to 1970, between the government and the Republic of Biafra, at war level.
The single year of data, 1968, falls within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's data for this group covers only 1968.
The fact pack has no figures for this group before or after that year.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or how they lived in Equatorial Guinea.
This is a year-end total for Equatorial Guinea only, reported to UNHCR.
